Metadata.description: FORTRA-PRODUCT-018 Maintenance (Derived) Pricing — stamps the pricing inputs the gated procedure formulas read. NEW business: stamps the source license line's pre-partner price (Pre_Partner_Price__c, else ListPrice, else UnitPrice) onto Base_Price__c so partner discounts do not corrupt the discount-immune base. RENEWAL: only derived maintenance lines (PriceBookEntryDerivedPrice gate); stamps the prior maintenance order line's Base + null-safe Partner$/Discretionary$ for the current Product2Id, with fallback to any prior order line with Base_Price__c > 0 (RRM from prior RNM). Then resolves COLA rate (line override -> category default). Also stamps QuoteLineItem.Fortra_Product_Type__c from Product2 when blank. Before-save, no DML, no recursion. OPEN ITEMS: (1) prior-OrderItem lookup is not account/asset-scoped; (2) COLA contract-override tier not resolved here; (3) COLA date-effectivity not filtered.
Metadata.label: Stamp Maintenance Pricing Inputs
